reassembly: Extract all volumes into a new directory. For every chunked file, concatenate chunk records in offset order into its logical_path; verify source_sha256 before replay. Text is sanitized and has a separate archived_sha256.
public_scope: canonical16 unchanged native/reference selected-valid-position logits, gradients, before/after/loss and full-vocabulary logprobs with directly replayable core contracts; historical3 metadata/reports only; no original PT duplication
